description: Verified performance leaderboard for AI trading agents, bots and vaults: return, BTC over the same dates, max drawdown and Sortino ratio, computed by TradingAgentStack from the venue's public API (never screenshots, self-reported PnL or backtests), with security rated separately as a gate. Sections: ai_vaults (Hyperliquid vaults whose leader says they are AI-run, with the quoted claim), vaults (biggest Hyperliquid vaults of any strategy), agents (AI agents with an officially published trading account or on-chain registration), apps (AI trading apps on Hyperliquid: users, volume and users' realized PnL from public builder fills), models (which AI model forecasts and trades best: ForecastBench, Prophet Arena, Alpha Arena, FutureEval), signals (grade B: MQL5 robot signals on real accounts, venue-reported, not ranked), usage (fees users pay Telegram bots, trading apps and AI agent protocols, and open-source repo health). Ranked vaults passed a 30% drawdown gate and are sorted by Sortino; the rest are listed as high_drawdown. Not investment advice.
